evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: The JD emphasizes governance, well-tested SQL, root cause analysis for data quality, and testing frameworks throughout with no velocity/speed language, so rigour.
evidence.domain_risk: Exposure to working in a regulated or enterprise environment is advantageous.
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: ASB is a bank (default-high-risk financial services sector), and the JD names a regulated environment explicitly, so high.
evidence.collaboration_width: Senior/Staff Engineers; Data Product Owners; Subject Matter Experts
evidence.data_team_maturity: This opportunity exists in the Data Product Engineering Squad in the Data & Analytics Platform... ASB operates in the Scaled Agile Framework, and the Data Engineering Chapter supports platforms, projects, and tribes across ASB
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: The JD describes a large, specialized organizational structure (squads, tribes, chapters, multiple dedicated Analytics Engineer roles across domains) operating at scale, so mature.
evidence.jd_authorship: Develop and maintain data models and pipelines using modern tools like dbt, Snowflake, and StreamSets. Write clean, well-tested SQL to transform raw data into reliable, analytics-ready datasets.
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: Named tools (dbt, Snowflake, StreamSets, Wherescape RED, Kimball/Inmon/Data Vault) with precise application context make the day-to-day work concrete, so hiring_manager.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: You'll play a key role in building and maintaining data products that power our Enterprise Data Warehouse
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: The role is framed around building data products within the internal Data & Analytics Platform and Enterprise Data Warehouse, so internal_data.
evidence.autonomy_level: You'll be guided by senior engineers and chapter leads while progressively taking ownership of your own workstreams.
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: The role is explicitly framed as guided/mentored with progressive (not immediate) ownership, and is junior-level, so execution.
evidence.ai_role_explanation: No AI tool or skill is mentioned anywhere in the JD as expected of the candidate.
evidence.testing_framing: Innovate & Contribute: Participate in code reviews, contribute to documentation and testing frameworks, and support the introduction of best practices that uplift the platform's maturity.
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Testing frameworks are named as something the candidate contributes to and owns as part of the role, so responsibility.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing: Support & Scale: Monitor and maintain data pipelines across cloud and on-prem environments, assist with incident resolution, and contribute to root cause analysis for data quality issues.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: Operational reliability (incident resolution, root cause analysis, pipeline monitoring) is a clear concern but framed alongside learning/growth and delivery, not as a dominant compliance/trust register, so moderate.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: The role primarily maintains, monitors, and scales existing data products and pipelines (with one migration project), so fix_scale.
evidence.loss_aversion: we have the right data, at the right time, reliably to make sound business decisions — operational reliability of data pipelines feeding business decisions is a secondary but present concern, not a dominant regulatory/trust register.
